name: MCP Ragdown
tagline: Your Markdown notes, searchable by every agent.
description: An MCP server over folders of Markdown files: it chunks them by heading, embeds the chunks into a local LanceDB index kept in sync with the files, and serves hybrid search per folder — plus a ragdown_context tool that lets a prompt hook add related notes to every turn. The files stay the source of truth; the index is disposable.
